caption: The drawing features a large, two-story house positioned centrally in the composition, painted in light tones of gray and lavender with a prominent triangular pediment, four columns at the front entrance, and two red brick chimneys on its roof. In front of the house, there is a symmetrical garden with a pathway leading directly to the entrance, bordered on either side by green grass and shrubbery. Four trees with light green foliage and brown trunks are aligned parallel to the pathway, two on each side, creating a symmetrical layout. Surrounding the scene, there are additional trees and bushes in various shades of green and some light gray-green, with a fence visible on each side of the garden. The sky is a pale beige, and the entire composition is rendered with soft, pastel colors, giving a gentle appearance to all objects. The artist’s signature, "G.E. Cook," appears in the lower right corner.
title: The Bowery House
